proposals.before: Zeng De of Yuyang was the fifty-seventh-generation descendant of Confucius.
proposals.after: Zeng De of Yuyang was the fifty-seventh-generation descendant of the Duke of Zongsheng.
proposals.reason: 宗聖公 is the temple title of Zengzi (Zeng Shen), not Confucius; the English wrongly substitutes Confucius.

proposals.before: He died in the second year of Zhiyuantong—exactly twelve years later, as he had vowed.
proposals.after: He died in the second year of Yuantong—exactly twelve years later, as he had vowed.
proposals.reason: 元統 is the Yuantong reign; Zhiyuantong is a fused mistranslation of 至 + 元統.

proposals.before: In the second year of Zhiyuantong he died—indeed matching the count of one cycle.
proposals.after: In the second year of Yuantong he died—indeed matching the count of one cycle.
proposals.reason: Same 元統 reign-name error as in the idiomatic line.

decisions.reason: s0082 has 宗聖公五十七代孫: 宗聖公 is Zengzi's temple title, not Confucius; the proposed idiomatic correctly restores Duke of Zongsheng.
s0100 has 至元統二年: 至 is the temporal verb "when it came to," and 元統 is the Yuantong reign; Zhiyuantong wrongly fuses them. Contrast s0102 至元二年, where Zhiyuan is the actual reign name.
The literal field has the same fusion of 至 + 元統 into Zhiyuantong; Yuantong correctly names the reign in 至元統二年.
